source_selection: Ten prespecified public operation/domain categories; ordinary typed ports frozen before law development. Upstream inspiration is independent software, but handwritten ports are kernels, not whole apps, and syntactic author bias remains. All included irrespective of measured outcome.
development: Synthetic controlled folds in a separate module; two development sizes/regime. Heldout sources and evaluation inputs never used to repair laws or profitability.
checkpoints: Pinned current complete catalogue, plus absorbing Boolean folds, plus controlled fold map/filter fusion; same epoch. Family removal ablations at full growth.
family_count: Incremental reusable mechanism count relative to frozen main. Support lemmas/type instances/adapters/duplicate endpoints are not families. No absolute count of the pre-existing catalogue asserted.
forced: Generic data-template discovery to fixed point, checked selection replay; lowest structural cost choice deliberately forced. No timings choose this lane.
automatic: Ordinary ink compile --optimise, fixed explicit budgets and default profitability. Development workload measurement only; heldout evaluation inputs unavailable to selection.

measurement.boundary: complete trusted call including all result construction and recursive bit-aware consumption; immutable inputs constructed outside. Import/setup, source read, proof/search/compile recorded separately.
measurement.memory: Separate per-variant process: observed heap/RSS, retained heap after GC and OS high-water RSS. No allocation/peak-live-memory inference. Complete result byte length is a distinct logical metric.
measurement.statistics: Per-case paired bootstrap 95%, 10000 resamples; fixed equal domain/program weights then equal sizes/distributions. Empty cases retained; headline nonempty cohort prespecified separately. No adding overlapping speedups.
measurement.concurrency: Serial benchmark cohorts; shared desktop/system contention recorded; cannot guarantee exclusive machine.

limits: No new JSON/CRDT/host primitives; binary32 order and wrapping words preserved. Pure kernels do not claim state/event/snapshot authority. Unsupported whole-system alternatives classified by exact limiting stage.
